name: Battleground Template
description: Properties of each joinable battleground: per-team player limits, level bracket (classic/tbc only), alliance and horde start locations with the maximum allowed start distance, and an optional player-skinning refloot id. Id is the battleground type id from BattlemasterList.dbc.

fields.name: Alliance Start Loc
fields.help: WorldSafeLocs.dbc id of the alliance start/spawn location.

fields.name: Horde Start Loc
fields.help: WorldSafeLocs.dbc id of the horde start/spawn location.

fields.name: Start Max Dist
fields.help: Maximum allowed distance from the start location (players farther away on start are teleported back).

fields.name: Player Skin Refloot Id
fields.help: Reference loot id used when skinning player corpses on this battleground; 0 = none.
